purpose: Independent fourth-domain corpus for M1-M6 multi-domain regression (P7). The domain is a library catalogue (books/authors/publishers/cities/collections), independent from the family-tree, organization, and supply-chain corpora. Topology is deliberately NOT an isomorphic renaming of any prior domain: 3 authors with uneven book counts (2/1/3), 2 publishers each serving a different-sized author group, 2 collections each holding exactly the books of one publisher's authors -- a different branching shape from both the organization corpus (uniform 2x2) and the supply-chain corpus (3-vs-1 asymmetry concentrated on a single branch).
